facts.text: The hotel sits along the Singapore River in the Robertson Quay district.

facts.text: Orchard Road, Marina Bay and the CBD are moments away from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: with Orchard Road, Marina Bay, and the CBD just moments away

facts.text: The hotel is at 1 Nanson Road, Singapore.
facts.excerpt: 1 Nanson Road Singapore, 238909 Singapore

facts.text: Fort Canning MRT Station is listed as the hotel's public transportation option.
facts.excerpt: - Fort Canning MRT Station

facts.text: Fort Canning Park is about 2 kilometers from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Fort Canning Park - 1.24 miles away (2 kilometers)

facts.text: The light-filled studios and suites blend elegance with a warm, residential feel.
facts.excerpt: Blending elegance with a warm, residential feel, each room is designed for a modern city stay

facts.text: Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows.
facts.excerpt: the floor-to-ceiling windows give them a more spacious feel

facts.text: Club InterContinental gives access to a private lounge overlooking Robertson Quay.
facts.excerpt: Club InterContinental, offering personalised service, exclusive privileges and access to our private lounge overlooking Robertson Quay

facts.text: The outdoor swimming pool is on the 4th floor.
facts.excerpt: The Swimming Pool is located on the 4th Floor.

facts.text: Complimentary Tokyo Bikes are available for exploring Robertson Quay, the Singapore River and neighbourhoods beyond.
facts.excerpt: Our complimentary Tokyo Bikes offer an easy way to explore Robertson Quay, the Singapore River and neighbourhoods beyond.

facts.text: The Quay Insider program helps guests discover Robertson Quay through a local lens.
facts.excerpt: Discover Robertson Quay through a local lens with The Quay Insider.

facts.text: The Concierge team gives personalised recommendations showcasing the riverfront neighbourhood.
facts.excerpt: personalised recommendations from our Concierge team that showcase our riverfront neighbourhood and beyond

facts.text: The riverfront area next to the hotel is a popular running route.
facts.excerpt: the riverfront area next to the hotel is a lovely (and popular) route for a run

facts.text: The hotel is in a lively food precinct with restaurants and bars at the doorstep.
facts.excerpt: Being smack-dab in a lively food precinct, with some of the city's coolest restaurants and bars at your doorstep.

facts.text: Publico Ristorante & Garden serves wood-fired pizzas and house-made pastas by the Singapore River.
facts.excerpt: Experience a slice of Italy by the Singapore River at Publico Ristorante & Garden, with wood-fired pizzas, house-made pastas

facts.text: Ishi, on the second floor, serves Japanese fine dining at a sushi counter.
facts.excerpt: Perched on the second floor of the hotel, Ishi, loosely translated as "Stone", presents Japanese fine dining over an elegant sushi counter.

facts.text: CODA is an intimate cocktail bar where Asian spirits take centre stage.
facts.excerpt: An intimate 15 seat avant garde cocktail bar, CODA immerses guests in a world of meticulously crafted cocktails, where Asian spirits take centre stage

facts.excerpt: Certifications: Achieved GSTC Certification

facts.excerpt: Only guide dogs or assistance dogs trained to assist a person with a disability are allowed.
